subject: agent://curia.example/tuesdaycrowd/scriptor
note: A log.operator-key entry with no jwk at 2 does not read as a key and holds no position: the entry at 3 is the first operator key, and the attestation at 4 signed by it is honoured. Statements are the exact output of CanonicalizeWithNfc, each signature is detached under curia-operator-act+jws with the key's thumbprint as the header kid; the keys the case publishes are its own log.operator-key, log.key and log.declaration-key entries. expected.json is written from this construction and never by running a verifier. A proposal: it may be regenerated until the owner's lift record pins its digests.
